bigIdeas.en: Fractions are a type of number that can represent quantities.
bigIdeas.zh: 分数也是一种数，可以用来表示数量。

bigIdeas.en: Development of computational fluency in addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of whole numbers requires flexible decomposing and composing.
bigIdeas.zh: 整数加减乘除要算得熟，靠的是灵活地把数拆开再合起来。

bigIdeas.en: Regular increases and decreases in patterns can be identified and used to make generalizations.
bigIdeas.zh: 规律里固定的增加或减少可以找出来，并用来总结规律。

bigIdeas.en: Standard units are used to describe, measure, and compare attributes of objects’ shapes.
bigIdeas.zh: 用标准单位来描述、测量和比较物体与图形的特征。

bigIdeas.en: The likelihood of possible outcomes can be examined, compared, and interpreted.
bigIdeas.zh: 各种结果出现的可能性，可以拿来观察、比较和解读。

elaborations.en: counting: skip-counting by any number from any starting point, increasing and decreasing (i.e., forward and backward); skip-counting is related to multiplication; investigating place-value based counting patterns (e.g., counting by 10s, 100s; bridging over a century; noticing the role of zero as a placeholder 698, 699, 700, 701; noticing the predictability of our number system)
elaborations.zh: 数数：从任何数开始、按任何数跳着数，往大数和往小数（顺着数、倒着数）；跳着数和乘法有关；探究和数位有关的数数规律（如 10 个 10 个、100 个 100 个地数；跨过整百；注意 0 占位的作用：698、699、700、701；发现我们的数系有规律可循）

elaborations.en: Numbers to 1000 can be arranged and recognized: comparing and ordering numbers; estimating large quantities
elaborations.zh: 1000 以内的数可以摆一摆、认一认：比较和排序；估计大数量

elaborations.en: place value: 100s, 10s, and 1s; understanding the relationship between digit places and their values, to 1000 (e.g., the digit 4 in 342 has the value of 40 or 4 tens); understanding the importance of 0 as a place holder (e.g., in the number 408, the zero indicates that there are 0 tens)
elaborations.zh: 数位：百位、十位、个位；懂得数位和位值的关系，到 1000（如 342 里的 4 表示 40，也就是 4 个十）；懂得 0 占位的重要（如 408 里的 0 表示十位上是 0 个十）

elaborations.en: instructional resource: Math in a Cultural Context, by Jerry Lipka
elaborations.zh: 教学资源：Math in a Cultural Context（Jerry Lipka）

elaborations.en: Fractions are numbers that represent an amount or quantity.
elaborations.zh: 分数是表示数量的数。

elaborations.en: Fractions can represent parts of a region, set, or linear model.
elaborations.zh: 分数可以表示一块区域、一组东西或一段长度的一部分。

elaborations.en: Fraction parts are equal shares or equal-sized portions of a whole or unit.
elaborations.zh: 分数的每一份是平均分出来的，大小一样。

elaborations.en: Provide opportunities to explore and create fractions with concrete materials.
elaborations.zh: 让孩子用实物探索和做出分数。

elaborations.en: recording pictorial representations of fraction models and connecting to symbolic notation
elaborations.zh: 把分数模型画下来，并和分数的写法对上

elaborations.en: equal partitioning
elaborations.zh: 平均分成几份

elaborations.en: equal sharing, pole ratios as visual parts, medicine wheel, seasons
elaborations.zh: 平均分享；杆影比例当作看得见的部分；药轮（medicine wheel）；四季

elaborations.en: using flexible computation strategies, involving taking apart (e.g., decomposing using friendly numbers and compensating) and combining numbers in a variety of ways, regrouping
elaborations.zh: 用灵活的计算策略：把数拆开（如用好算的数拆分、补偿法）再用各种办法合起来；进位和退位

elaborations.en: estimating sums and differences of all operations to 1000
elaborations.zh: 估算 1000 以内各种运算的和与差

elaborations.en: using addition and subtraction in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和问题里用加减法

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班一起聊数（number talks）

items.en: addition and subtraction facts to 20 (emerging computational fluency)
items.zh: 20 以内加减法口算（初步熟练）

elaborations.en: adding and subtracting of numbers to 20
elaborations.zh: 20 以内数的加减

elaborations.en: demonstrating fluency with math strategies for addition and subtraction (e.g., decomposing, making and bridging 10, related doubles, and commutative property)
elaborations.zh: 熟练运用加减法的策略（如拆数、凑十和过十、相关的双倍、交换律）

elaborations.en: Addition and subtraction are related.
elaborations.zh: 加法和减法是有关系的。

elaborations.en: At the end of Grade 3, most students should be able to recall addition facts to 20.
elaborations.zh: 到三年级结束，大多数学生应该能直接说出 20 以内的加法口算。

elaborations.en: understanding concepts of multiplication (e.g., groups of, arrays, repeated addition)
elaborations.zh: 理解乘法的意思（如「几组几个」、排成几行几列、连加）

elaborations.en: understanding concepts of division (e.g., sharing, grouping, repeated subtraction)
elaborations.zh: 理解除法的意思（如平均分、每几个一组、连减）

elaborations.en: Multiplication and division are related.
elaborations.zh: 乘法和除法是有关系的。

elaborations.en: Provide opportunities for concrete and pictorial representations of multiplication.
elaborations.zh: 让孩子用实物和图画来表示乘法。

elaborations.en: Use games to develop opportunities for authentic practice of multiplication computations.
elaborations.zh: 用游戏来真实地练乘法。

elaborations.en: looking for patterns in numbers, such as in a hundred chart, to further develop understanding of multiplication computation
elaborations.zh: 在数里找规律（如百数表），进一步理解乘法计算

elaborations.en: Connect multiplication to skip-counting.
elaborations.zh: 把乘法和跳着数联系起来。

elaborations.en: Connect multiplication to division and repeated addition.
elaborations.zh: 把乘法和除法、连加联系起来。

elaborations.en: Memorization of facts is not intended for this level.
elaborations.zh: 这个年级不要求背口诀。

elaborations.en: fish drying on rack; sharing of food resources in First Peoples communities
elaborations.zh: 晾在架子上的鱼；原住民社区里分享食物

elaborations.en: creating patterns using concrete, pictorial, and numerical representations
elaborations.zh: 用实物、图画和数来创造规律

elaborations.en: representing increasing and decreasing patterns in multiple ways
elaborations.zh: 用多种方式表示递增和递减的规律

elaborations.en: generalizing what makes the pattern increase or decrease (e.g., doubling, adding 2)
elaborations.zh: 总结是什么让规律变大或变小（如翻倍、每次加 2）

items.en: pattern rules using words and numbers, based on concrete experiences
items.zh: 用文字和数说出规律法则（从实物出发）

elaborations.en: from a concrete pattern, describing the pattern rule using words and numbers
elaborations.zh: 看着实物摆出的规律，用文字和数说出规律法则

elaborations.en: predictability in song rhythm and patterns
elaborations.zh: 歌曲节奏和规律里的可预测性

elaborations.en: Share examples of local First Peoples art with the class, and ask students to notice patterns in the artwork.
elaborations.zh: 和全班分享本地原住民的艺术作品，请学生找出作品里的规律。

items.en: one-step addition and subtraction equations with an unknown number
items.zh: 一步加减方程（含一个未知数）

elaborations.en: start unknown (e.g., n + 15 = 20 or □ + 15 + 20)
elaborations.zh: 开头的数不知道（如 n + 15 = 20 或 □ + 15 = 20；官网原文写成 □ + 15 + 20）

elaborations.en: change unknown (e.g., 12 + n = 20 or 12 + □ = 20)
elaborations.zh: 变化的数不知道（如 12 + n = 20 或 12 + □ = 20）

elaborations.en: result unknown (e.g., 6 + 13 = n or 6 + 13 = □;)
investigating even and odd numbers
elaborations.zh: 探究偶数和奇数

items.en: measurement, using standard units (linear, mass, and capacity)
items.zh: 用标准单位测量（长度、质量、容量）

elaborations.en: linear measurements, using standard units (e.g., centimetre, metre, kilometre)
elaborations.zh: 用标准单位量长度（如厘米、米、千米）

elaborations.en: capacity measurements, using standard units (e.g., millilitre, litre)
elaborations.zh: 用标准单位量容量（如毫升、升）

elaborations.en: Introduce concepts of perimeter, area, and circumference (the distance around); use of formula and pi to calculate not intended — the focus is on the concepts.
elaborations.zh: 初步认识周长、面积和圆的一圈有多长（围一圈的距离）；不要求用公式和 π 计算——重点是概念。

elaborations.en: area measurement, using square units (standard and non-standard)
elaborations.zh: 用方块单位量面积（标准的和非标准的）

elaborations.en: mass measurements, using standard units (e.g., gram, kilogram)
elaborations.zh: 用标准单位量质量（如克、千克）

elaborations.en: estimation of measurements, using standard referents (e.g., If this cup holds 100 millilitres, about how much does this jug hold?)
elaborations.zh: 借助标准参照物估计测量结果（如这个杯子装 100 毫升，那这个壶大约装多少？）

elaborations.en: understanding concepts of time (e.g., second, minute, hour, day, week, month, year)
elaborations.zh: 认识时间单位（如秒、分、时、天、星期、月、年）

elaborations.en: understanding the relationships between units of time
elaborations.zh: 懂得时间单位之间的关系

elaborations.en: Telling time is not expected at this level.
elaborations.zh: 这个年级不要求会看钟表读时间。

elaborations.en: estimating time, using environmental references and natural daily/seasonal cycles, temperatures based on weather systems, traditional calendar
elaborations.zh: 借助环境线索和大自然每天 / 每季的循环估计时间；天气系统带来的气温；传统历法

elaborations.en: identifying 3D objects according to the 2D shapes of the faces and the number of edges and vertices (e.g., construction of nets, skeletons)
elaborations.zh: 根据面的平面形状、棱和顶点的个数认出立体图形（如做展开图、骨架）

elaborations.en: describing the attributes of 3D objects (e.g., faces, edges, vertices)
elaborations.zh: 描述立体图形的特征（如面、棱、顶点）

elaborations.en: identifying 3D objects by their mathematical terms (e.g., sphere, cube, prism, cone, cylinder)
elaborations.zh: 用数学名称说出立体图形（如球、正方体、棱柱、圆锥、圆柱）

elaborations.en: comparing 3D objects (e.g., How are rectangular prisms and cubes the same or different?)
elaborations.zh: 比较立体图形（如长方体和正方体哪里一样、哪里不一样？）

elaborations.en: understanding the preservation of shape (e.g., the orientation of a shape will not change its properties)
elaborations.zh: 懂得形状不变（图形换个方向摆，性质不变）

elaborations.en: jingle dress bells, bentwood box, birch bark baskets, pithouses
elaborations.zh: jingle dress 上的铃铛、弯木箱（bentwood box）、桦树皮篮子、半地穴屋（pithouse）

items.en: one-to-one correspondence with bar graphs, pictographs, charts, and tables
items.zh: 条形统计图、象形统计图、图表和表格（一个对一个）

elaborations.en: collecting data, creating a graph, and describing, comparing, and discussing the results
elaborations.zh: 收集数据，画统计图，并描述、比较和讨论结果

elaborations.en: choosing a suitable representation
elaborations.zh: 选一种合适的表示方式

items.en: likelihood of simulated events, using comparative language
items.zh: 模拟事件有多可能发生（用比较的说法）

elaborations.en: using comparative language (e.g., certain, uncertain; more, less, or equally likely)
elaborations.zh: 用比较的说法（如 一定、不一定；更可能、更不可能、同样可能）

elaborations.en: developing an understanding of chance (e.g., tossing a coin creates a 50-50 chance of landing a head or tail; drawing from a bag, using spinners, and rolling dice all simulate probability events)
elaborations.zh: 初步理解「机会」（如抛硬币，正面和反面的机会一半一半；从袋子里摸东西、转转盘、掷骰子都在模拟可能性事件）

elaborations.en: story: The Snowsnake Game (yukon-ed-show-me-your-math.wikispaces.com/file/view/The%20Snowsnake%20Game.pdf/203828506/The%20Snowsnake%20Game.pdf)
elaborations.zh: 故事：The Snowsnake Game

items.en: financial literacy — fluency with coins and bills to 100 dollars, and earning and payment
items.zh: 认识钱：100 元以内的硬币和纸币，挣钱和付钱

elaborations.en: counting mixed combinations of coins and bills up to $100: totalling up a set of coins and bills; using different combinations of coins and bills to make the same amount
elaborations.zh: 数硬币和纸币混在一起的总数，到 100 元：算出一堆硬币和纸币的总数；用不同的硬币和纸币组合凑出同一个金额

elaborations.en: understanding that payments can be made in flexible ways (e.g., cash, cheques, credit, electronic transactions, goods and services)
elaborations.zh: 懂得付钱的方式很灵活（如现金、支票、信用卡、电子支付、用东西或帮忙来换）

elaborations.en: understanding that there are different ways of earning money to reach a financial goal (e.g., recycling, holding bake sales, selling items, walking a neighbour’s dog)
elaborations.zh: 懂得为了达到一个理财目标，可以用不同的办法挣钱（如回收瓶罐、卖点心、卖东西、帮邻居遛狗）

elaborations.en: Using pictures of First Peoples trade items (e.g., dentalium shells, dried fish, or tools when available) with the values indicated on the back, have students play a trading game.
elaborations.zh: 用原住民交易物品的图片（如角贝、鱼干或工具），背面标上价值，让学生玩交易游戏。
